description: This is a PHP source file defining a controller class for an OpenCart dashboard extension 'recent'. It manages rendering the recent orders dashboard, saving configuration, and retrieving recent orders data.

classes.name: Recent
classes.description: Controller class for managing the 'Recent' dashboard extension in OpenCart, handling display, configuration saving, and recent data retrieval.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the Recent dashboard configuration page with breadcrumbs, layout options, and common components like header and footer.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving configuration settings for the Recent dashboard extension, with permission check and JSON response.

methods.name: dashboard
methods.description: Retrieves the 5 most recent orders and renders the related info view for the dashboard widget.
